title: About Teleport
description: Help you solve issues about teleport.
body:
### Feature List
- Guide Book.
- Spawn \(/trigger jkat.spawn\).
- Warp \(/trigger jkat.warp\).
- Home \(/trigger jkat.sethome & jkat.home\).
- Random Teleport \(/trigger jkat.tpr\).
- Back \(/trigger jkat.back\).
- Player-to-player \(P2P\) \(/trigger jkat.tpa & jkat.tpahere\).
- Vertical & Horizontal Lift.
- Warp Pearl.

For admins, all of the above items can be freely configured!

#### Getting the Guide
- Admin: `/function jkat:op/guide`
- Player: `/trigger jkat.guide`

### Notes
- Install the datapack in `/saves/<world_folder>/datapacks/`.
- In-game, use `/reload` or `/function #load`; if text appears, the installation is successful.
- This datapack only supports the Overworld, The Nether, and The End dimensions.
- When teleporting to a fixed point \(not random or P2P\), entities that are leashed or ridden can also be teleported.
